stock-miasma-recipient.scope: Stock Miasma 61 produced child 701 on QAEnemy: stats 1009 and 1010 at -14 for 5 s. Overlap refreshed the pair and the last pair 274/275 expired at PacketLog 3306.

aura.source: GOB 61 has ApplyAuraEffect for child 701 and drains 3 IS per 5 s. Child 701 grants -14 melee and ballistic defense for 5 s.
aura.runtime: AbilityAuras pulses child 701 on each caster's schedule and TimedEffects replaces the active child pair for the recipient. The child expires independently when both casters turn off.
aura.test: StarterHackerHostileAurasMode verifies adds, replaced record IDs, surviving caster pulses and final removals. PR564 PacketLog verifies the Miasma request at 2248, overlap refreshes at 2655/2799/2837 and final removals at 3306. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/564

aura.source: GOB 89 has ApplyAuraEffect for instant viral child 694 and drains 12 IS per 5 s.
aura.runtime: AbilityAuras maintains each toggled source with an independent charge and schedules hostile instant pulses. There is no lasting recipient modifier.
aura.test: StarterHackerHostileAurasMode checks caster independence and exclusion. PR564 PacketLog records the stock request at 3568, pulses from both casters at 3579/3816 and helper-only pulses at 4528/4778 after CSR stops. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/564

behavior-tests.source: GOB 941 runs ApplyAuraEffectOnHealthChange for child 942 and ISDrainWithAbilityDeactivation for 7 IS each second.
behavior-tests.runtime: AbilityHealthCallbacks applies child 942 once for each external damage or healing transaction while the parent is active. AbilityBuffs collects charges, deactivates on shortfall and emits the 15 s off timer.
behavior-tests.test: StarterHackerReactiveCodeMode and PR545 verify one 50 HP child hit for external damage and another for external healing, friendly exclusion, toggle-off, no inactive proc and 15 s reuse. HealthChangeListenerDrainsStillChargeAndTerminateWithAllExistingOffRecords covers exact upkeep and depletion. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/545

behavior-tests.source: GOB 943 runs ApplyNextAuraEffectHealthChance with value 30 for child 944 and drains 6 IS each second through ISDrainWithAbilityDeactivation.
behavior-tests.runtime: AbilityHealthCallbacks gates child 944 on a 0–99 value and runs the active parent once per external health transaction. AbilityBuffs ends the listener on toggle-off or insufficient IS and starts the 15 s reuse.
behavior-tests.test: CodeConversionUsesTheThirtyPercentBoundaryOncePerHealthChange checks roll 29, roll 30, once-per-event recursion and off state. PR545 and StarterHackerReactiveCodeMode verify the friendly +60 pulse and the 15 s toggle-off timer. HealthChangeListenerDrainsStillChargeAndTerminateWithAllExistingOffRecords covers exact upkeep and depletion. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/545
